svg.text: Market size, policy-exit resilience, and carbon-neutral buildout
Reduced-order post-processing of city-route profitability; durable neutrality counted separately from recycled-carbon products.
Profitable deployable CO2 by market category
2060 profit pool under policy exit and shocks
Billion USD/yr; zero means no profitable selected capacity after stress filters.
First profitable year with and without support
Bar fill = profitable durable CO2 capacity; target bars = 0.5/1.0/1.5 GtCO2/yr.
Overlay is not durable neutrality capacity; CSV reports oil-combustion debit.
1. Commodity-only profitability is much narrower than the policy-supported case; mineralization and selected SAF/CO routes are the main survivors.
2. Shock scenarios change both margins and buildable volume; product-demand shocks mainly hit chemicals/fuels, while network shocks mainly hit storage.
3. EOR is oilfield-constrained and receives no durable-removal credit in the conservative accounting.
